name: Racism
overview: Scripture teaches that all human beings are created in the image of God, affirming the inherent dignity and worth of every person regardless of race or background, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27. The Bible emphasizes that God does not show partiality among people (Acts 10:34) and that all nations are made from one blood (Acts 17:26), underscoring the unity and equality of mankind. Believers are called to love one another as Christ loved them (John 13:34) and to judge righteously rather than by outward appearances (John 7:24), rejecting any form of discrimination or favoritism. This foundational truth challenges any justification of racism or slavery, affirming that all people are equally valuable before God.
